def components(mask, connectivity=1):
    labs,n=ndi.label(mask, structure=ndi.generate_binary_structure(2,connectivity))
    out=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        pts=np.argwhere(labs==i)
        lo=pts.min(axis=0); norm=pts-lo
        h,w=norm.max(axis=0)+1
        sh=tuple(sorted(map(tuple,norm.tolist())))
        out.append((i, pts, (h,w),sh))
    return out
